title: 'Eat the rich': Indonesians protest against graft, wildfires

blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia —Thousands of Indonesians protested in Jakarta and other cities on Wednesday against economic hardship, graft and the government’s handling of devastating wildfires emitting a toxic haze that has made thousands ill. Many demonstrators held up the three-finger salute of rebellion from dystopian franchise “The Hunger Games” and waved posters with angry messages such as: “Hungry? Eat the Rich!” and “If we burn, you burn with us.” Many placards expressed anger towards President Prabowo Subianto, whose popularity two years into his term has reached record lows amid claims of widespread government corruption and growing authoritarianism.
